messages.subject: [NMF-user] NMF prediction with new data
messages.body_plain:
Dear all,
I used NMF to cluster my RNA-seq cancer samples obtaining an optimum k=3 but now I would like to use a new dataset and see where these new samples cluster.
Is it possible to do with the R package NMF?
Thanks,
